previous_last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for experimental causal time-budget dwell planning. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); guide target for a separate docs PR: docs/11-Ignition/Ignition-Settings/Experimental-Timing.md (not claimed public here). The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Adds opt-in causal time-budget dwell planning with occurrence ownership and physical-deadline bounds; Legacy remains default, but eligibility and retarget limits need guidance.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Time-budget planning requires individual coils and keeps Legacy fallback; each target is tied to one TDC occurrence.

[firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/ignition_retarget.h](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/ignition_retarget.h): Retargeting enforces causal ETA, minimum dwell and the physical output deadline.

[firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp): Superseded callback generations are invalidated before replacement callbacks are registered.
guide target: docs/11-Ignition/Ignition-Settings/Experimental-Timing.md (reviewed path; separate docs PR)

decisions.rationale: Adds independent full-precision load selectors for fuel, ignition, protection and actuator consumers, with fallback and diagnostic semantics that users must configure correctly.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Independent full-precision load coordinates and per-function selector UI are added for the listed consumers.

[firmware/controllers/algo/airmass_loads.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/algo/airmass_loads.cpp): Captured consumer coordinates are resolved after fuel publication and invalidated by tune generation changes.

[firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini): Per-consumer load-source fields and diagnostic cursors are exposed independently of Fuel strategy.
